scenario.name: baseline_dynamic_merge
scenario.rationale: Initial balanced scenario providing realistic traffic headway (~1.7s) and mild speed variation along a 180m acceleration strip, requiring dynamic gap selection without extreme congestion.

hypothesis: With traffic moving near ego speed and heterogeneous speeds across vehicles, the ego agent cannot reliably merge blindly at initial entry; it must observe the gap dynamics in lane 1 and decide between accelerating to merge ahead of the nearest vehicle or easing off to merge into the trailing pocket.
